environment.description: Node.js Express application deployed on an EC2 instance behind an Application Load Balancer. The ALB forwards all traffic on port 443 to the target group. No authentication middleware is configured. The application is accessible via the public ALB DNS name. Security groups allow inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. The LDAP server is reachable from the EC2 instance on the internal VPC.

config.network: Public ALB -> EC2 target group, SG allows 0.0.0.0/0:443 inbound
config.authentication: None - all requests forwarded directly to application
config.ldap_connectivity: EC2 has direct route to ldap.internal.corp:389 via VPC
